source: Bonaparte, González Riga & Apesteguía 2006, Cretaceous Research 27: 364-376, Fig. 8: strict consensus of two MPTs for Ligabuesaurus, a slanted cladogram with angled tip labels along the top, numbered nodes and bracketed support values (e.g. 51/46) beside clade names; 20 tips. The figure prints 'Diplodocus carnegii' and 'Jobaria tinguidensis' where the matrix has 'Diplodus longus' and 'Jobaria tiguidensis'. Image: page render of the embedded image's area at 600 dpi (4167x2508 px), as printed: the embedded image is a 1-bit mask that extracts white-on-black.
gold_note: 20 tips, slanted (diagonal) cladogram with the spine rising to the right. Node 5 is a 3-way polytomy (Ligabuesaurus, Phuwiangosaurus, rest): both branches meet the spine at the same point. Diplodocus joins the Jobaria branch (node 15); Mendozasaurus and Aeolosaurus pair (node 17) before joining Isisaurus (node 16). Matrix spellings are used where the figure differs: Diplodus_longus (printed Diplodocus carnegii), Jobaria_tiguidensis (printed tinguidensis), Opisthocoelicaudia_skarzynski (printed skarzynskii).
